text: Bitcoin is holding steady near recent highs with modest gains, while Ethereum and smaller altcoins are slipping—a pattern suggesting selective strength in the largest asset rather than broad-based conviction. The Fear & Greed index sits in greed territory but has cooled significantly over the past week, indicating sentiment may be topping out after recent momentum. Bitcoin's rising dominance to 59.3% combined with $94B in daily volume reflects traders rotating toward perceived safety, though the mixed price action across major assets suggests caution is tempered by optimism rather than driven by it.
